compatibilityNotes: Emulators and real hardware require a legally obtained ROM matching the target machine. Non-good variants may be useful for preservation study but can behave differently in emulators.
contentsDescription: ECS-era Kickstart with 2.x Workbench, improved color modes, and better hard drive support.
history: 1990–1992: ECS machines (A500+, A600, A3000) shipped with Kickstart 2.x. SuperKickstart images exist for A3000.
purpose: Stored in ROM (or loaded from disk on early A1000 setups), Kickstart initializes custom chips, brings up Chip RAM, installs core libraries, and hands control to boot media or the Workbench desktop.
summary: Kickstart is the Amiga's resident operating system firmware. This beta image targets Amiga hardware and provides the Exec kernel, device drivers, Intuition GUI, and DOS library needed to boot Workbench or games.
technicalInsights: A500+ and A600 images are not always interchangeable.
Developer and KickIt builds expose extra debug tooling.
Dump class: Beta — verify behavior before relying on it for production emulation.
title: Kickstart v2.0 beta 5 r36.067
